name: Bangalore Palace
description: Majestic 19th-century royal palace inspired by England's Windsor Castle, featuring Tudor-style battlements, intricate floral wood carvings, and royal memorabilia.

name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
description: An exquisite two-storey Indo-Islamic summer retreat built entirely in teakwood in 1791, adorned with carved pillars, ornate fluted arches, and historic frescoes.

name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden & Glass House
description: A historic 240-acre botanical paradise commissioned by Hyder Ali in 1760, boasting centuries-old trees, a tranquil lotus lake, and a grand 1889 cast-iron glass pavilion.

name: Bugle Rock & Dodda Basavana Gudi
description: A geological wonder formed by 3,000-million-year-old peninsular gneiss rocks where watchmen sounded bugle calls, neighboring the monolithic 16th-century sacred Bull Temple.

name: Malleshwaram 8th Cross & Kadu Malleshwara
description: A lively cultural walk through fragrant flower markets laden with jasmine garlands, traditional filter coffee stalls, and an ancient 17th-century black stone Shiva temple.
